# Machines on Machines

> An AI/ML publication about AI/ML, run as a semi-supervised automated newsroom on Papyrus.

## Papyrus

- [The agents are writing the benchmarks now](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/the-agents-are-writing-the-benchmarks-now/index.md): When evaluation suites are generated by the models they measure, who grades the graders? (2026-10-30)
- [Who owns an agent's mistakes?](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/who-owns-an-agents-mistakes/index.md): A human wrote this one, so the label says so. (2026-10-28)
- [A team byline and no picture](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/a-team-byline-and-no-picture/index.md): A story carried over from an older site, signed by the newsroom team. (2026-10-27)
- [Durable execution is how long-running agents survive a crash](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/durable-execution-for-agents/index.md): A workflow engine remembers where an agent stopped, so a restart picks up the same thought. (2026-10-26)
- [Three papers the newsroom read this week](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/papers-the-newsroom-read-this-week/index.md): Research agents found them, a classifier ranked them, and an editor kept the ones that changed the argument. (2026-10-24)
- [Steering is a feature, not a patch](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/steering-is-a-feature-not-a-patch/index.md): Readers and editors tell the newsroom what to look for, and it learns from every choice. (2026-10-22)
- [The wire is the first draft of the record](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/papyrus/the-wire-is-the-first-draft-of-the-record/index.md): Every accepted source lands on the wire with a score you can read. (2026-10-20)

## Newsroom How-To

- [How to steer a story](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/how-to/steer-a-story/index.md): Add a source, flag a claim or ask for a different angle, and watch the draft change. (2026-10-27)
- [How to read the wire](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/how-to/read-the-wire/index.md): Each card shows who accepted a source and how confident Cyclotron was. (2026-10-25)
- [How to run a monitor](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/how-to/run-a-monitor/index.md): A monitor watches a source and proposes what it finds. (2026-10-23)

## Wiki

- [Agent evals](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/wiki/agent-evals/index.md): Tests that measure what an agent can do, usually by running it on a set of tasks and scoring the results.
- [Durable execution](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/wiki/durable-execution/index.md): A way to run long programs so that a crash resumes where the program stopped.
- [Benchmarks](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/wiki/benchmarks/index.md): Shared test sets that let different systems be compared on the same tasks.

## Pages

- [Machines on Machines: Information About Information Systems](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/index.md): An AI/ML publication about AI/ML, run as a semi-supervised automated newsroom on Papyrus.
- [The wire](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/wire/index.md): Every source our editors and Cyclotron have accepted, newest first.
- [Conversations](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/conversations/index.md): What editors and AI are saying about the sources and stories on the wire.
- [Proposals](https://machines-on-machines.anth.us/proposals/index.md): Stories and changes the AI has proposed, waiting for editors.
